clips.title: The story
paras: Oslow's Toolbox contains the vital construction tools needed by Foreman Oslow in Lakeshire. En route from Goldshire, the supplies were ferried across Lake Everstill only to be sunk by an orcish catapult bombardment.

Maintaining the defenses and infrastructure of Lakeshire is a grueling challenge, particularly with the Blackrock orcs besieging the Redridge Mountains. Foreman Oslow ordered a vital set of construction tools brought in from Goldshire. Because the main bridge leading into Lakeshire had been destroyed by enemy action, the shipment had to be loaded into a rowboat to cross Lake Everstill. The crossing was abruptly cut short when Blackrock forces struck the vessel with a catapult blast, plunging the boat and Oslow's heavy chest straight down into the murloc-infested depths.
